decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s established finishing portfolio that was publicly presented and fits its service-based customer offering, management is likely to continue backing it despite limited later website evidence.
Its fully automatic positioning matches the firm’s stated direction toward automation and digital print finishing, so prior commitment and strategic fit make withdrawal relatively unlikely.

The booklet maker supports the firm’s core finishing business and integrated customer workflow offering, so a management shaped by escalation of commitment would be inclined to retain it unless clear failure became undeniable.
